chunks.screen: Run real Tab P F N inference locally. It estimates whether sales during supplier lead time could exceed stock, assuming no receipt. Failed inference never gets a substitute score.

chunks.screen: Rolled oats shows the disagreement. Both simple baselines show cover, but the model estimates about eighty-four percent risk. This recurring-demand illustration was selected after exploring model outputs; it is not an independent test.
